title: = ANY(ARRAY(...)) over a huge per-user allowed set
issue: id = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT my_doc_ids())) builds (and sorts) an N-element array before the first row, so even a PK lookup pays O(N) for users with many grants.
symptom: naive_rls PK lookup latency grows with the subject's grant count (user 1: ~0.1 ms, user 9999: tens of ms).

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents; grants: user 1 = 10, user 5000 = scale/20, user 9999 = scale/2
